fs_drag slice IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED 2026-07-15. FsWallFriction closed enum, all 8 upstream correlations (Churchill, Colebrook, ReynoldsPower, Rehme, Engel, modifiedEngel, BaxiDalleDonne, NoKazimi) incl. wire-wrap geometry constructors. V&V (6 tests, all pass): Churchill laminar limit f*Re=64 to <1e-10 (Re<=1000); Churchill turbulent vs Colebrook-White smooth-pipe at Re=1e5 = 0.017875 vs 0.017990 (0.64%); Engel f=99/Re; blend continuity; algebraic + geometry exactness. NOTE crate-wide compile currently blocked by OTHER fleet agents' WIP in neutronics/multi_region/thermo_mechanics (not TH); TH module is independent (uom/approx only).
VERIFIED in-tree: whole crate compiled in a clean window (concurrent fleet edits transient) and all 6 fs_drag V&V tests passed (6 passed; 75 filtered). Also independently verified via standalone crate (byte-identical source, 6/6) + Android aarch64-linux-android check clean + clippy -D warnings clean.
